newsitem.title: FRANCE: Special Greek maize export tender to end in May.
newsitem.headline: Special Greek maize export tender to end in May.

text.p: A special tender for the export of 100,000 tonnes of Greek maize will expire in May 1997, grain industry sources said on Friday.
The startup date for the tender has however yet to be set, they said.
The EU's grain committee agreed on Thursday to open the tender.
The measure is aimed at providing an outlet for excess maize production in the northern Greek region of Orestiada and avoid sales to intervention stores, industry grain sources have said.
